tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport (wire) compression codec, chosen because its compression ratios are much better than those of the codec it replaced. No other settings for the codec, such as compression level, are recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says the project's recorded decision is zstd as the transport compression codec, chosen for its much better ratios. It also says no other codec settings, such as compression level, are recorded.

The zstd decision is Muninn record #5, stated directly by the user. Nothing later replaces it. Record #25 is about certificate verification, so it doesn't touch this. The file doesn't name the codec zstd replaced.

The first attempt to write the file with a shell heredoc failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the file tool instead, and it was created.

The Muninn heartbeat also reported a RED warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it. It didn't stop the records from loading.
